disruption_recovery.state_transition: a required service becomes unavailable and later recovers, forcing a wait-versus-substitute decision under deadline
disruption_recovery.negative_failure: commit to the unavailable service before recovery or wait past the deadline

time_window_scheduling.state_transition: a broad arrival window contains a narrower interval in which a minimum accumulated dwell duration must be completed
time_window_scheduling.negative_failure: arrive in the broad window but accumulate the dwell outside the narrow interval

resource_budget_allocation.state_transition: the first purchase consumes the only inventory claim and determines which affordable downstream service remains feasible
resource_budget_allocation.negative_failure: consume the inventory claim on the decoy purchase and lose downstream affordability

poi_availability_service_evidence.state_transition: a referral service produces evidence that unlocks a second provider service at another POI
poi_availability_service_evidence.negative_failure: use the provider without prior referral evidence

memory_conditioned_preference.state_transition: two recalled memories conflict and the decision must follow the source tagged as reliable under the current cue
memory_conditioned_preference.negative_failure: follow the newer but explicitly unreliable memory

social_coordination_copresence.state_transition: a confirmation message authorizes a timed physical handoff rather than a generic meeting
social_coordination_copresence.negative_failure: meet without acquiring or handing off the required item

multi_party_commitment.state_transition: evidence from the first timed meeting must be carried into a later meeting with a second partner
multi_party_commitment.negative_failure: complete only one meeting or reverse the relay order

compound_long_horizon.state_transition: a credential service unlocks a labeled purchase, which unlocks a timed service before return
compound_long_horizon.negative_failure: skip the credential or execute the purchase/service chain out of order
